name: ftprovertime
description: Weekly FTPR and four-week rolling average.

queries.label: ftpr_data
queries.sql_text:
WITH repo_specs AS (
  SELECT owner, name, from_ts, to_ts
  FROM JSON_TABLE(
    :repo_specs,
    '$[*]' COLUMNS (
      owner VARCHAR(255) PATH '$.owner',
      name VARCHAR(255) PATH '$.name',
      from_ts BIGINT PATH '$.from' NULL ON EMPTY,
      to_ts BIGINT PATH '$.to' NULL ON EMPTY
    )
  ) AS specs
),
pr_rows AS (
  SELECT
    'pr' AS row_type,
    pr.id AS id,
    pr.is_draft,
    pr.merged_date,
    pr.created_date,
    pr.author_name,
    pr.status AS status,
    pr.description,
    pr.title,
    (
      SELECT prc.commit_sha
      FROM lake.pull_request_commits prc
      WHERE prc.pull_request_id = pr.id
        AND prc.commit_authored_date <= pr.created_date
      ORDER BY prc.commit_authored_date DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ) AS head_commit_sha,
    NULL AS pipeline_id,
    NULL AS pipeline_name,
    NULL AS result,
    NULL AS finished_date
  FROM lake.pull_requests pr
  JOIN lake.repos r
    ON r.id = pr.base_repo_id
  JOIN repo_specs rs
    ON r.name COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CONCAT(rs.owner, '/', rs.name) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci
  WHERE pr.status = 'MERGED'
    AND pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL
    AND (rs.from_ts IS NULL OR UNIX_TIMESTAMP(pr.merged_date) >= rs.from_ts)
    AND (rs.to_ts IS NULL OR UNIX_TIMESTAMP(pr.merged_date) <= rs.to_ts)
),
first_commits AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT head_commit_sha
  FROM pr_rows
  WHERE head_commit_sha IS NOT NULL
),
standard_pipeline_rows AS (
  SELECT
    'pipeline' AS row_type,
    NULL AS id,
    NULL AS is_draft,
    NULL AS merged_date,
    NULL AS created_date,
    NULL AS author_name,
    NULL AS status,
    NULL AS description,
    NULL AS title,
    cpc.commit_sha AS head_commit_sha,
    cp.id AS pipeline_id,
    cp.name AS pipeline_name,
    cp.result,
    cp.finished_date
  FROM lake.cicd_pipeline_commits cpc
  JOIN lake.cicd_pipelines cp
    ON cpc.pipeline_id = cp.id
  JOIN first_commits fc
    ON fc.head_commit_sha = cpc.commit_sha
  WHERE cp.status = 'DONE'
    AND cp.result IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILURE')
    AND LOWER(cp.name) NOT LIKE '%coderabbit%'
    AND LOWER(cp.name) NOT LIKE '%codecov%'
),
prow_pipeline_rows AS (
  SELECT
    'prow' AS row_type,
    NULL AS id,
    NULL AS is_draft,
    NULL AS merged_date,
    NULL AS created_date,
    NULL AS author_name,
    NULL AS status,
    NULL AS description,
    NULL AS title,
    ctj.commit_sha AS head_commit_sha,
    ctj.job_id AS pipeline_id,
    ctj.job_name AS pipeline_name,
    ctj.result,
    ctj.finished_at AS finished_date
  FROM lake.ci_test_jobs ctj
  JOIN repo_specs rs
    ON ctj.organization COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = rs.owner COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci
   AND ctj.repository COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = rs.name COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci
  JOIN first_commits fc
    ON fc.head_commit_sha = ctj.commit_sha
  WHERE ctj.job_type IN ('prow', 'tekton')
    AND ctj.trigger_type = 'pull_request'
    AND ctj.result IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILURE')
)
SELECT * FROM pr_rows
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM standard_pipeline_rows
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM prow_pipeline_rows

tests.name: Unknown repository returns an error instead of a zero chart
tests.assert_script: if (!output || output.error !== 'No merged PRs found for this time period') throw new Error('expected no-merged-PRs error'); if (output.type || output.data) throw new Error('empty FTPR must not return chart data');
